name: cockpit
steps: log click the ENGINE switch with the real mouse path (mousemove + mousedown at its screen position)

eval (()=>{ const b=__G.cockpit.hitBoxes.find(h=>h.userData.sw==='engine'); const p=new __G.THREE.Vector3(); b.getWorldPosition(p); p.project(__G.zCam); const x=(p.x+1)/2*innerWidth, y=(1-p.y)/2*innerHeight; window.__sw0=__G.D.engineSwitch; dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',{clientX:x,clientY:y})); return [Math.round(x),Math.round(y)]; })()
eval (()=>{ const ev=new MouseEvent('mousedown',{button:0,clientX:0,clientY:0,bubbles:true}); dispatchEvent(ev); return {sw:__G.D.engineSwitch, before:__sw0, fireFlag:false}; })()
log fire extinguisher button by click

eval (()=>{ const b=__G.cockpit.hitBoxes.find(h=>h.userData.sw==='fire'); const p=new __G.THREE.Vector3(); b.getWorldPosition(p); p.project(__G.zCam); dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',{clientX:(p.x+1)/2*innerWidth, clientY:(1-p.y)/2*innerHeight})); return 1; })()
